description: Send a candidate a brief for a real work sample: what you need, the context and when you need it. Before sending, ask the user for anything missing (what they need, their company, their name and email) and show them the brief, since the candidate gets notified. The candidate accepts or declines in made.show and replies with the work and their reasoning. Returns a token: keep it in the conversation and pass it to get_work_sample to check the status or read the work.

contactEmail.description: Email the candidate's reply goes to

contactName.description: Name of the person sending the brief

context.description: Links or background, e.g. your docs, design system or repo

deadline.description: When you need it, as YYYY-MM-DD

description.description: The brief: what you want made, the ambition, constraints

title.description: Short name for the brief, e.g. "Onboarding flow redesign"

name: request_work_sample
title: Request a work sample
